name: Flag Pride Philadelphia
description: In the LGBTQ+ community, we signify our pride with flags. With many different identities in the community, there comes many different flags to know.This pride flag is Philadelphia's adopted version in 2017, which includes black and brown to represent LGBT communities of color.
notes: Outline and Mono are Fluent System Icons artwork, unmodified except for a currentColor rewrite. Standard is NOT shipped by Fluent — it is generated here by insetting the filled glyph in a gradient tile.
